name: Essential Tremor
definition: Common neurological syndrome characterized mainly by bilateral upper-limb action tremor, with or without head or voice tremor, in the absence of another better explanation.

core: Tremor at rest, posture and action

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; laboratory testing targets mimics.
investigations.MRI: MRI is used when atypical neurological features are present.

amber: Propranolol/primidone and advanced therapies require individualized contraindication and specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kampa phenotype may be documented, but essential tremor should remain distinct from Parkinson disease and other causes.

patientEducation.summary: Common neurological syndrome characterized mainly by bilateral upper-limb action tremor, with or without head or voice tremor, in the absence of another better explanation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
